title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: From the legendary details of the Knight statue to the annual fireworks of Sparks at Knight, these traditions define the Bellarmine experience in Louisville.

cards.title: Decoding the Knight's Details
cards.subtitle: A 13-foot bronze sculpture by Bob Lockhart
cards.notes: Examine the statue to find ten lizards representing life's irritations and a fortune cookie hidden among the bells on the horse's leg.
cards.short_summary: A massive bronze mascot statue filled with symbolic and humorous hidden details by artist Bob Lockhart.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bellarmine Knight sculpture features ten lizards representing irritations and a fortune cookie among the bells on the horse's leg.
cards.source_title: A Knight's Tale/Tail Two - Knights of Creativity Spirit & Ale
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors on the main campus walkway near the library; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Sparks at Knight Fireworks
cards.subtitle: The annual welcome-back carnival
cards.notes: Attend this carnival on the first Saturday of the fall semester, featuring games and a massive fireworks display at 9:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall semester kickoff carnival for students and staff that concludes with a signature fireworks show.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparks at Knight is a welcome back carnival taking place annually on the first Saturday of the fall semester, culminating in fireworks at 9:30 pm.
cards.access_notes: Held on the campus grounds during the first week of the fall semester.

cards.title: Late Knight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Fueling up before Study Day
cards.notes: Head to the University Dining Hall the night before Study Day to be served a free breakfast by university faculty and staff.
cards.short_summary: A semesterly tradition where faculty and staff serve students breakfast to support them before final exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Faculty and staff serve a free breakfast to students in the University Dining Hall each semester on the night before Study Day.
cards.access_notes: Takes place in the University Dining Hall during finals week; check campus calendar for exact late-night hours.

cards.title: Ball on the Belle
cards.subtitle: A Halloween cruise on the Ohio River
cards.notes: Board the Belle of Louisville for this annual Halloween dance party and river cruise organized by the Bellarmine Activities Council.
cards.short_summary: An annual Halloween-themed dance party held aboard the historic Belle of Louisville steamboat.
cards.evidence_claim: Ball on the Belle is an annual Halloween Dance Party where the university rents out the Belle of Louisville for a cruise down the Ohio River.
cards.access_notes: Requires boarding at the Louisville waterfront; transportation is typically provided from campus.

cards.title: The Hillside Concert
cards.subtitle: Spring music in the natural amphitheater
cards.notes: Join the crowd for this annual spring concert, named for its original location on the hill behind the Brown Activities Center.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing spring concert series featuring contemporary musical artists performed for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillside Concert is a spring tradition at Bellarmine, named because the original concert was held in the natural amphitheatre on the hillside.
cards.source_title: Bellarmine concert by Sara Bareilles a sellout
cards.access_notes: Location varies between the campus hillside and Knights Hall; check current year event details.

cards.title: Knights in Action Day
cards.subtitle: First-year service tradition
cards.notes: Join your entire first-year class to volunteer at nonprofit sites across Louisville during the final days of the Week of Welcome.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale community service event where the entire incoming freshman class participates in local volunteer projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Knights in Action is a program where the entire first-year class goes to nonprofit community partner sites to complete projects at the end of Week of Welcome.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students as part of the BU100 course curriculum.

cards.title: The President's Toast
cards.subtitle: A Senior Week celebration
cards.notes: Gather in the Centro Atrium during Senior Week for a formal toast with the University President to celebrate your upcoming graduation.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory event for graduating seniors featuring a toast by the University President during the week of commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: The President's Toast is a Senior Week event for graduating seniors held in the Centro Atrium.
cards.source_title: Senior Week and Graduate Events - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open to graduating seniors; typically held in the afternoon during Senior Week.

cards.title: The Golden Egg Quest
cards.subtitle: Spring campus-wide scavenger hunt
cards.notes: Search the campus grounds during the spring semester to find hidden eggs, including the rare golden eggs that carry high-value prizes.
cards.short_summary: A competitive spring egg hunt where students search for prizes ranging from small treats to electronics.
cards.evidence_claim: Egg Quest is a spring semester hunt where students find eggs around campus to claim prizes, including golden eggs with high-value items.
cards.access_notes: Open to all current students; held outdoors across the main campus.

cards.title: Photos at the Arch
cards.subtitle: A graduation rite of passage
cards.notes: Visit the stone arch on Newburg Road during Senior Week to take your official commemorative graduation photos with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A traditional photo opportunity for graduating seniors at the university's iconic stone entrance arch.
cards.evidence_claim: Photos at the Arch is a Senior Week tradition held at the Bellarmine Arch on Newburg Road.
cards.source_title: Senior Week and Graduate Events - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Located at the campus entrance on Newburg Road; accessible 24/7 for photos.

cards.title: Late Knight Bingo
cards.subtitle: High-stakes Homecoming fun
cards.notes: Join this high-energy Homecoming Week event to compete for prizes in a packed room of fellow Knights.
cards.short_summary: A popular Homecoming Week event where students play bingo for various prizes in a social setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Knight Bingo is a signature event held during the annual Homecoming Week.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in Frazier Hall or the University Dining Hall; check the Homecoming schedule for times.
